body.statement: Can one construct from \(\mathsf{Handle}_{\mathrm{cert}}\) a measurable radius \(R_\ell\) such that \(\mathcal C_\ell(R_\ell)\) has asymptotic coverage at least \(1-\alpha\) uniformly over \(\mathcal M\), has diameter \(O_{\Pr}(n_\ell^{-1/2}+m_\ell^{-1/4})\), uses the DKW branch with probability \(o(1)\) on every supported fixed local stratum, satisfies \(R_\ell^2/a_\ell\to c^*(\eta,\alpha)\) conditionally on \(\mathscr S_\eta\), learns within-cell offsets exactly at the local limit while retaining cross-cell translations and face offsets in the nuisance region, and reduces only on fixed separated interior strata with continuous nondegenerate critical law to the corresponding oracle cutoff?
body.justification: This is the load-bearing open content: one total procedure must remain honest through support, covariance-rank, and simplex-face changes while attaining the conditional deterministic-cutoff frontier.
body.gap: Chen supplies residual-matching DSC and Alvarez--Orestes supplies continuous-cell quantile-mixture inference, but no located result combines exact quantile-span DSC, atomic endpoint conditioning, estimated face weights, nuisance exclusion budgeting, and certified common-cutoff attainment.
body.consumer: A successful construction permits an unsmoothed simultaneous \(L^2\) reanalysis of the Zhai et al. mosquito-abundance QTE curves relative to the donor-identified post-treatment no-intervention law, while excluding their separate binary elimination estimand.

obligation.what_is_open: Construct one measurable finite-sample support-cluster, covariance-rank, and simplex-face procedure whose certified cutoff is uniformly honest over \(\mathcal M\), whose fallback probability vanishes on every supported fixed local stratum, and whose normalized radius converges conditionally to \(c^*(\eta,\alpha)\).
obligation.obstruction: The frozen handle and nuisance set specify an architecture but do not define a measurable support relabeling, confidence-region map, uniform Gaussian coupling error, or nuisance-exclusion budget.  The proved oracle compactification does not by itself control arrays with changing unseen atoms, covariance rank, and active faces, so declaring attainment would assume the crux.
obligation.attempted: Conditioned on the exactly observed within-cell offsets; capped unresolved translations and face offsets on Gaussian tail boxes; enumerated endpoint orders and active sets; budgeted primitive-region exclusion, Gaussian tails, and interval error; and retained the DKW radius on certification failure.  The missing step is a uniform raw-sample coupling and measurable selection proof showing eventual successful refinement on every supported fixed stratum.
obligation.partial_result:
The proved pieces already give (i) the exact finite decomposition with remainder \(o_{\Pr}(a_\ell)\), (ii) the conditional Gaussian target
\[
 c^*(\eta,\alpha)=\sup_{\theta\in\Gamma_\eta}
 Q_{1-\alpha}^{\Pr_{\eta,\theta}}(\mathcal L_{\eta,\theta}),
\]
(iii) a tail-box compactification and terminating oracle interval calculation for fixed certified \(\eta\), and (iv) an always-valid DKW ball of diameter
\(O(n_\ell^{-1/2}+m_\ell^{-1/4})\).  In a within-cell atom of mass \(p_\ell=d/\sqrt{m_\ell}\), its count \(N_\ell\) satisfies
\[
 \frac{N_\ell}{\sqrt{m_\ell}}\longrightarrow d,
 \qquad
 \operatorname{Var}\left(\frac{N_\ell}{\sqrt{m_\ell}}\right)
 =p_\ell(1-p_\ell)\longrightarrow0,
\]
so the internal offset is consistently learned, whereas root-\(m_\ell\) translations between independent cells and root-\(n_\ell\) face offsets retain nondegenerate noise and must remain in \(\Gamma_\eta\).  What is not yet proved is one finite-sample measurable selection and error-budget argument that estimates all strata uniformly and makes the fallback probability vanish on every supported fixed local stratum.
